title: Lightened up Marry Me Chicken Pasta with Cottage Cheese
reject_reason: Marry Me Chicken = creamy sun-dried-tomato/parmesan chicken; over pasta it is the same dinner as live slow-cooker-tuscan-chicken-pasta (shares chicken, sun-dried tomato cream, parmesan, pasta), a lane the estate has repeatedly folded into the Tuscan-cream chicken identity.
